name: Visakhapatnam — Bay of Bengal shelf
establishment: Eastern Naval Command; NSTL (Naval Science & Technological Laboratory, UUV/torpedo hydrodynamics)
region: Bay of Bengal, east India narrow continental shelf

water.source: representative regional climatology (INCOIS / WOA); Bay of Bengal is freshened by river runoff -> lower surface salinity and strong near-surface stratification

notes: All attacks run here; the site sets the ENVIRONMENT, not the attack set.
